summary.en: An aurora rises slowly from the foot of a light frame, then the ground drops to near black in a third of a second and the aurora becomes an afterglow; the next line blurs in after a gap.
summary.zh: 浅底上极光从画框底部慢慢升起，随后整片底色在约 0.36 秒内压到近黑、极光压成余晖；旧句先虚化消失，空一拍后新句虚化入场。

fits: The turn of a story told by the ground itself: before / after, “for years …” → “now …”, the one accent of a calm film.
notFor: A film already dark, or with more than one change of ground; a turn that is not the story’s main one; fast films (the build is two thirds of it).

intent.en: The whole ground drops from light to dark after a long build, so the viewer feels the story turn before reading the next line.
intent.zh: 长长的铺垫之后整片底色由亮压暗，让观众在读到下一句之前先感到故事转了。

content.en: Two lines: the before line on the light ground and the after line on the dark (≤ 30 chars each), usually a "for years …" / "now …" pair.
content.zh: 两句话：亮底上的“之前”句和暗底上的“之后”句（每句 ≤ 14 字），通常是“多年以来……/现在……”一对。

fits.zh: 由底色本身讲的故事转折：之前与之后，“多年以来……”到“现在……”，安静片子里唯一的重音。

notFor.zh: 已经是深色的片子，或底色换不止一次；不是故事主转折的转折；快节奏的片子（三分之二时长在铺垫）。

pairs.note: the after line can enter with blur in the empty beat

en: Leave the gap: the new line comes after the flip with an empty beat, never cross-faded with the old one.
Once a film, as the main turn; never in the same film as whiteout-slam.
Recolour the aurora as a whole with the line colours; changing only the text colour detaches it from the ground.
zh: 留出空档：新句在反转之后、空一拍再入，不和旧句交叉淡化。
一支片只用一次，用在主转折；不和 whiteout-slam 同片。
要换极光颜色就连同文字色整组换，只换文字色会和底色脱节。

upstream.name: 极光升腾反黑
upstream.summary: 浅灰底从底部升起紫橙柔焦 blob，随后整个底色在约 0.36s 内压暗到近黑、blob 压成余晖；文案同步 blur-out 换句 blur-in，换句间留空档不 cross-fade
upstream.use: 叙事转折点（"多年以来…→一切都变了"）；品牌片从铺垫拉到重音的那一拍；深浅色系之间的段落切换
upstream.energy: 由低到高（前 2/3 是酝酿，压暗那一瞬是全片重音）

fits: any with a light and a dark preset

overlaps.note: a peak by exposing to white; ground-flip is a peak by dropping to dark; never both
batch 1: a slow drift between grounds (T0), no accent
